correctness.rationale: The primitive torus character exactly counts integer crossings of the independently Haar-phase-shifted random minimum displacement. Convolution and conditional Bernoulli interpolation prove the complete PMF. Uniform mod-1 displacement proves the +1/6 second-moment correction. Coprimality recovers the reduced denominator of 12mu, and exact quadratic algebra recovers the ordered absolute slope via two moments. Exact rational checker, endpoint simulations and independently enumerated lifted-segment intersections corroborate correct formulas across nontrivial examples.

value.rationale: The inverse is meaningful on the natural infinite set of primitive torus homology classes: the exact average intersection count alone uniquely recovers the unordered absolute winding pair, although aspect ratio is arbitrary and unknown. The full nontrivial rational PMF and second moment provide independently explicit distributions and a continuously invertible ratio with sharp 16..18 endpoints. This is more structural than computing a single isolated example.
